newsitem.title: USA: Cigna tenders shrs of Healthsource.
newsitem.headline: Cigna tenders shrs of Healthsource.

text.p: CIGNA Corp said Monday it has tendered 63,116,768 shares of Healthsource Inc common stock, including 1,093,091 shares tendered according to notices of guaranteed delivery.
The company said it is extending its offer to buy all outstanding shares of common stock of Healthsource Inc for $21.75 per share, net to the seller in cash until Wednesday, June 25.
The offer had previously been scheduled to expire on Friday, June 20.
The offer, which was made through its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, CHC Acquisition Corp, is being extended because not all of the required regulatory approvals have been obtained.
The terms of the extended offer otherwise remain the same as those of the original offer as set forth in the offering materials filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 6.
The depository for the offer as of June 20 is IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Co. The information agent for the offer is Georgeson & Co Inc. The Dealer Managers are Goldman, Sachs & Co.
